description: Approved page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.8.html (2026-11-08), following Elixir's own path (../elixir: IO.write is the one write over :io.put_chars; IO.puts = write + newline; IO.inspect = puts(inspect(item)) returning item; Kernel.dbg is library code over inspect and IO.write). fz mirrors it piece for piece: StdoutOutput::emit writes bytes and stops appending a newline; one extern fz_io_write(binary) :: :ok hands bytes to the output hook (write_output replaces emit_print_line); lib/io.fz defines write/1, puts/1, inspect/1 with Elixir's bodies over String.Chars (a list argument raises ArgumentError until chardata is built; a map or tuple is refused at compile time naming String.Chars); Kernel.dbg(x) becomes IO.inspect(x), deleting fz_dbg_value and fz_dbg_value_ref. dbg prints what our IO.inspect prints; any difference from Elixir's text is a renderer fix in fz-sc8.10, never an adapter. Census pins over dbg-using programs rise by the measured mechanism (dbg(1): 69 jobs/3 lowered -> ~111/11 per program); the builder reports, the coordinator authorizes. DbgCapture splits bytes on newline; drive_test's fz_dbg_value-keyed tests move to fz_send. fz-sc8.55 folds in as the top-level IO.puts fixture. No longer depends on fz-sc8.10.
title: IO.puts/1 writes a string to stdout
